### A Call to Commitment
Author: Ligonier Ministries
Site: Ligonier Ministries
URL: https://learn.ligonier.org/devotionals/call-to-commitment
Passage: John 12:42-43
Points:
- True saving faith requires knowledge, mental assent, and personal reliance on Jesus Christ.
- Genuine faith produces visible fruit, specifically the willingness to confess Christ publicly before others.
- Several Jewish authorities believed in Jesus' claims but stayed silent out of fear of expulsion.
- Valuing human praise over God's honor serves as a sobering warning against half-hearted allegiance.
- Personal faith must never be kept secret, calling believers to openly identify with Jesus and His church.
